title: "Edit and publish website content"

::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this task achieves

Use this route to edit ordinary website text, links, images, page details or
navigation, then review and publish the change.

> **Do not use this route to correct published statistics or generated files.**
> Make those changes through the relevant analytical or reporting workflow.

## Before you start

- Complete the [workstation setup](../getting-started/workstation-setup.qmd) and
  identify the public source page that needs changing.
- Confirm that any analytical product used by the page has already been
  approved and published.
- Be ready to work on a development branch. Do not edit or push directly to
  protected `main`.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
Confirm responsibility, scope and wording → prepare a development branch → edit,
preview and render → review and merge → check the live website.
:::

## Complete the following steps

| Order | Manual | Task | Detailed guidance |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Confirm authorised responsibility and the correct change route** — named owner; ordinary public content; analytical corrections excluded | Check the [BNR Developer and Publisher responsibilities](../../operations/operating-model/roles-decision-rights.qmd#core-roles) and [what may be edited directly](../website/update-content.qmd#what-this-page-does). |
| 2 | [Public Methods]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--methods} | **Preserve approved statistical meaning, where relevant** — definitions; interpretation; limitations; public wording | Use the [Public Methods Manual](../../methods/index.qmd) when the change explains a statistic or method. |
| 3 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Prepare a current development branch** — local editing session; latest protected `main`; short task-specific branch name | Follow [Start the editing session, update `main` and create a development branch](../website/render-publish.qmd#step-1-start-the-editing-session). |
| 4 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Edit and test the public source** — smallest required QMD or Markdown change; local preview; complete site render; affected pages and links checked | Follow [Update website content](../website/update-content.qmd) from opening the source page through the complete local render. |
| 5 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Review and publish the controlled change** — intended files only; commit and push; pull-request review and merge; successful deployment; correct live page | Continue with [Inspect the files to commit, then publish and check the website](../website/render-publish.qmd#step-5-inspect-the-files-to-commit). |

## How to confirm completion

The task is complete when the pull request is merged, the latest **Publish
Quarto site** build and deployment have succeeded, and the affected live page
shows the intended change.
